chunks.title: Emails > Email Campaigns > Can I Send a Mass Email Campaign Using Brilliant Directories?
chunks.heading: Overview of Mass Emailing Capabilities
chunks.text:
Emails > Email Campaigns > Can I Send a Mass Email Campaign Using Brilliant Directories?
Category: Emails > Email Campaigns
Section: Overview of Mass Emailing Capabilities

The built-in Brilliant Directories email newsletter system is designed specifically for emailing active members who have opted in to receive updates, such as monthly community newsletters or billing reminders. It is NOT intended for unsolicited cold outreach or massive third-party blast marketing.

It is NOT intended for unsolicited cold outreach or massive third-party blast marketing.

chunks.title: Emails > Email Campaigns > Can I Send a Mass Email Campaign Using Brilliant Directories?
chunks.heading: Recommendations for Large Outreach
chunks.text:
Emails > Email Campaigns > Can I Send a Mass Email Campaign Using Brilliant Directories?
Category: Emails > Email Campaigns
Section: Recommendations for Large Outreach

If you plan to send cold email campaigns or outreach to tens of thousands of external leads, we strongly advise integrating with dedicated email platforms such as Mailchimp, SendGrid, or ActiveCampaign via our API and Webhooks.
chunks.snippet: If you plan to send cold email campaigns or outreach to tens of thousands of external leads, we strongly advise integrating with dedicated email platforms such as Mailchimp, SendGrid, or ActiveCampaign via our API and Webhooks.

chunks.title: Emails > Email Accounts > Setting Up Domain Email Accounts and MX Records
chunks.heading: Connecting 3rd Party Email Providers
chunks.text:
Emails > Email Accounts > Setting Up Domain Email Accounts and MX Records
Category: Emails > Email Accounts
Section: Connecting 3rd Party Email Providers

You can connect your custom domain to third-party email providers such as Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, or Zoho. To do this, point your custom domain's MX records to Google Workspace or your chosen provider in your DNS manager or cPanel.
chunks.snippet: You can connect your custom domain to third-party email providers such as Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, or Zoho. To do this, point your custom domain's MX records to Google Workspace or your chosen provider in your DNS manager or cPanel.

chunks.title: Emails > Email Accounts > Setting Up Domain Email Accounts and MX Records
chunks.heading: Webmail vs External Hosting
chunks.text:
Emails > Email Accounts > Setting Up Domain Email Accounts and MX Records
Category: Emails > Email Accounts
Section: Webmail vs External Hosting

Brilliant Directories provides basic default webmail accounts for your admin domain, but professional agencies recommend routing all primary inbox traffic through Google Workspace for superior spam deliverability.

chunks.text:

Section: Creating Email Forwarders

Email forwarders allow you to automatically forward incoming emails sent to an address on your domain (e.g. info@yourdirectory.com) to an external personal or team inbox (e.g. yourname@gmail.com) without requiring a separate paid mailbox.

chunks.title: My Members > Member Categories > How to Import Categories via CSV File
chunks.heading: Category Structure Overview
chunks.text:
My Members > Member Categories > How to Import Categories via CSV File
Category: My Members > Member Categories
Section: Category Structure Overview

Brilliant Directories supports a 3-tier category hierarchy:
1. Top-Level Category (e.g. Healthcare, Legal, Home Services)
2. Sub-Category (e.g. Dentistry, Cardiology)
3. Sub-Sub-Category (e.g. Pediatric Dentistry, Orthodontics)
Each member can be assigned 1 Top-Level category and multiple Sub or Sub-Sub categories.
[Screenshot Information: Screenshot of Member Categories screen showing top action bar with 'Add Top Category' and orange 'Import Categories' buttons.]

chunks.title: Finance > Payment Gateways > How to Set Up Stripe Payment Gateway
chunks.heading: Overview of Stripe Integration
chunks.text:
Finance > Payment Gateways > How to Set Up Stripe Payment Gateway
Category: Finance > Payment Gateways
Section: Overview of Stripe Integration

Brilliant Directories natively integrates with Stripe to process credit card payments, recurring membership subscriptions, paid lead purchases, and digital product sales. It fully supports Stripe SCA (Strong Customer Authentication) and 3D Secure 2 compliance.
[Screenshot Information: Screenshot showing Finance > Payment Gateways screen with Stripe selected, Publishable Key field, Secret Key field, and Test Mode toggle button.]
chunks.snippet: Brilliant Directories natively integrates with Stripe to process credit card payments, recurring membership subscriptions, paid lead purchases, and digital product sales. It fully supports Stripe SCA (Strong Customer Authentication) and 3D Secure 2 compliance.

chunks.title: Finance > Payment Gateways > How to Set Up Stripe Payment Gateway
chunks.heading: Step-by-Step Stripe Setup
chunks.text:
Finance > Payment Gateways > How to Set Up Stripe Payment Gateway
Category: Finance > Payment Gateways
Section: Step-by-Step Stripe Setup

1. Navigate in your Admin Dashboard to Finance > Payment Gateways.
2. In the Gateway Dropdown, select 'Stripe'.
3. Click the blue 'Connect with Stripe' button or manually input your Stripe Publishable Key and Secret Key.
4. Ensure your Stripe Webhook endpoint is copied from BD into your Stripe Dashboard at Developers > Webhooks (endpoint: https://yourdomain.com/stripe_webhook.php).
5. Set Webhook events to listen for: 'invoice.payment_succeeded', 'customer.subscription.deleted', and 'charge.refunded'.
[Screenshot Information: Screenshot showing Finance > Payment Gateways screen with Stripe selected, Publishable Key field, Secret Key field, and Test Mode toggle button.]

chunks.heading: Processing Refunds in Admin Dashboard
chunks.text:
Finance > Transaction Management > How to Manage Member Refunds and Cancellations
Category: Finance > Transaction Management
Section: Processing Refunds in Admin Dashboard

To refund a transaction:
1. Go to Finance > Transaction History.
2. Locate the transaction using the member search or invoice ID.
3. Click the 'Action' dropdown on the right side and select 'Refund Transaction'.
4. You can choose Full Refund or Partial Refund by entering a custom amount.
5. When processed, Brilliant Directories calls Stripe/gateway API to refund the card and automatically generates a negative credit note invoice.
[Screenshot Information: Screenshot of Transaction History table with highlighted Action button showing dropdown items: View Invoice, Send Receipt, and Refund Transaction.]

chunks.title: Finance > Transaction Management > How to Manage Member Refunds and Cancellations
chunks.heading: Handling Member Cancellations
chunks.text:
Finance > Transaction Management > How to Manage Member Refunds and Cancellations
Category: Finance > Transaction Management
Section: Handling Member Cancellations

To cancel a recurring subscription without refunding prior payments:
1. Go to My Members > Search Members.
2. Click 'Quick Edit' on the member record.
3. Change Status from 'Active' to 'Cancelled' or 'Past Due'.
4. Toggle 'Cancel Gateway Subscription' to stop future automated recurring charges in Stripe immediately.

chunks.title: Developer Tools > API & Webhooks > Webhooks and API Integration Guide
chunks.heading: Setting Up Outbound Webhooks
chunks.text:
Developer Tools > API & Webhooks > Webhooks and API Integration Guide
Category: Developer Tools > API & Webhooks
Section: Setting Up Outbound Webhooks

1. Go to Developer Tools > Webhooks.
2. Click 'Add New Webhook'.
3. Select Trigger Event (e.g. 'member_signup').
4. Enter Target Webhook URL (e.g. Zapier or webhook receiver).
5. Test payload: BD sends a JSON POST request containing all user profile fields.
[Screenshot Information: Screenshot of Developer Tools > Webhooks showing list of active endpoints and 'Test Webhook Payload' button.]
